title: Quick Draft
description: Mini form to start a new post draft without leaving the dashboard. On submit, navigates to the full editor.

documentation.purpose: Lower-friction entry point for short posts. Substack-style: title + a few lines of body, Save Draft commits the post and routes to the full editor for follow-up.

states.renders: Title input + textarea + Save Draft button.
Loading button; inputs remain editable but submit is disabled.
Error message above the submit button.

interactions.effect: `saveEntityRecord('postType','post', {title, content, status:'draft'})` → invalidate the recent-drafts query → `navigate('#/posts/{id}/edit')`.

constraints.note:
WordPress rejects fully-empty posts (`Content, title, and excerpt are empty`). The widget seeds `

` when the textarea is blank — same workaround `core:simple-editor` uses.

The recent-drafts widget queries `useEntityRecords` with a specific query shape; saveEntityRecord doesn't auto-invalidate it. The widget calls `invalidateResolution('getEntityRecords', ['postType','post', { …same query as recent-posts widget… }])` so the sibling tile refreshes after a new draft saves.

design-system-leakage.purpose: Multiline body input — WPDS 0.12 has no TextareaControl port.
